newsitem.title: CANADA: Petro-Canada refinery back in operation.
newsitem.headline: Petro-Canada refinery back in operation.

text.p: Petro-Canada said on Friday it completed repairs to its 116,000 barrel a day Edmonton refinery and the plant was back in full operation on August 5.
The refinery was operating at reduced levels after a mechanical problem on July 13.
Petro-Canada said it expected after-tax costs for interim supply arrangements and repairs would be about C$12 million, which was to be reflected in third-quarter earnings from operations.
The company said it experienced no problems providing customers with product during for the time after the incident. ((Jeffrey Jones, Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
